import importlib.util, itertools

m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def run_basis(qids, costs, columns, target):
    return m.minimum_basis(list(qids), list(costs), list(columns), len(target), tuple(target))

# brute-force cross-check on random instances
import random
def brute(qids, costs, columns, target, n):
    best=None
    for mask in range(1<<n):
        combo=[i for i in range(n) if mask>>i&1]
        vecs=[tuple(columns[i][p] for i in combo) for p in range(len(target))]
        if m.partition_of(vecs)==tuple(target):
            c=sum(costs[i] for i in combo)
            cand=(c,len(combo))
            if best is None or cand<best: best=cand
    return best
rng=random.Random(5)
for t in range(400):
    n=rng.randint(0,10); npf=rng.randint(1,8)
    alpha='ABCDEF'
    columns=[tuple(rng.choice(alpha[:rng.randint(1,4)]) for _ in range(npf)) for _ in range(n)]
    qids=['q%d'%i for i in range(n)]
    costs=[rng.randint(1,15) for _ in range(n)]
    full=[tuple(columns[i][p] for i in range(n)) for p in range(npf)]
    target=m.partition_of(full)
    got=run_basis(qids,costs,columns,target)
    exp=brute(qids,costs,columns,target,n) if n<=14 else None
    if n<=14:
        assert (got[1],got[2])==exp, (t,got,exp,qids,costs,columns)
    else:
        # just validity
        sel=set(got[0])
        vecs=[tuple(columns[i][p] for i in range(n) if qids[i] in sel) for p in range(npf)]
        assert m.partition_of(vecs)==tuple(target)
print('minimum_basis unit + random checks OK')
